profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft | Backend & Cloud Infrastructure | Distributed Systems, Secure Cloud Services | C#, C++, Python
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting backend and cloud infrastructure systems in highly regulated and mission‑critical environments.

I currently work as a Software Engineer at Microsoft on the Azure Cloud Transfer Service, where I help build and operate distributed services that securely transfer data between government and sovereign cloud environments. My work focuses on reliability, security, automation, and system correctness at scale.

Across my career, I’ve led the development of security‑critical backend services, built CI/CD pipelines to improve delivery stability, supported new cloud deployments, and worked hands‑on with system design, debugging, and production support. I enjoy owning services end‑to‑end—from design and implementation through deployment, on‑call, and long‑term maintenance.

Prior to Microsoft, I worked as a Senior Principal Software Engineer at BAE Systems and as a Senior Systems Engineer at Raytheon Missile Systems, where I developed and integrated large‑scale software systems, transitioned monolithic applications to service‑based architectures, and collaborated directly with customers in fast‑paced, high‑reliability environments.

Technically, my background is strongest in backend and infrastructure engineering, with experience in C#, Python, C++, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and CI/CD automation. I also enjoy mentoring junior engineers and working across teams to solve complex problems.

I’m particularly interested in backend, cloud compute, and infrastructure roles where reliability, scale, and engineering fundamentals matter.
